name: omni-token
description: Context window weather, tok/s, prompt-cache hit rate and TTL, and cache auto-warm, in the band above the prompt

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last request: 1h on most Claude subscriptions, 5m on the API default or in usage overage

autoWarm.title: Auto-warm the prompt cache
autoWarm.description: While the session is idle, re-read the cached prefix with a tiny forked request shortly before it expires. Each warm bills a cache read of the whole context plus a few hundred output tokens

warmHours.title: Keep warm for (hours)
warmHours.description: Stop auto-warming this many hours after the last turn started, and let the cache expire
